subject: Accessing the data used as input to stan

messages.author: 46cba21b1581d4d8
messages.subject: Accessing the data used as input to stan
parts:
Hi, 

I am using blavaan with stan as the target. I saved the stan model and the .stan file for my model. I would like to use the code composed by blavaan as a starting point and manipulate it further. However, blavaan seems to have transformed the data I used as an imput in the bcfa call. Is there any way to retrieve the data used as an imput to stan from the blavaan result?

Thank you in advance for any help,

Matthias

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Accessing the data used as input to stan
parts:
Matthias,

I assume you obtained the stan file via the argument "mcmcfile=TRUE".
If so, that will save a second file called "semstan.rda" which
contains the necessary data, initial values, and monitors (the latter
could be supplied to the "pars" argument of stan()):

load("semstan.rda")
# data list:
stantrans$data
# initial values
stantrans$inits
# monitors/pars
stantrans$monitors

Ed
